title: Metagenomics analysis of bacterial diversity and antibiotic resistance dynamics in wastewater effluent-irrigated soil  in an agricultural microcosm setting
description: The aim of this study was to determine the impact of wastewater irrigation on bacterial community and antibiotic resistance dynamics in soil and vegetables in an agricultural setting. 16S rRNA gene metagenomics and shotgun metagenomics methods were used to determine bacterial diversity, occurrence and overall dynamics of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) in effluent irrigated soil from a microcosm setting.
center: Botswana International University of Science and Technology
samples: MIMARKS Survey related sample from wastewater metagenome
MIMS Environmental/Metagenome sample from wastewater metagenome
MIMS Environmental/Metagenome sample from soil metagenome
environmental sample; urban association not established
